adaptive-core.inputs: Raw IRQ clock, presentation phase, pending publication, both bounded damage histories and current intent packet; routine-specific arguments are source-local.
adaptive-core.outputs: Updated scheduler debt/cadence, bounded journal records or reduced drawing callbacks; carry reports composition or refusal as documented locally.
adaptive-core.clobbers: A, B, D, X, Y, U and condition codes except source-preserved values; stack returns balanced.
adaptive-core.reads: IRQ frame/publication counters, page-$34 journals/state and the current sixteen-byte intent packet.
adaptive-core.writes: Only page-$34 journals/state and explicitly saved/restored foreground intent fields.
adaptive-core.side_effects: Calls the always-mapped simulation and drawing bindings; never publishes FRONT directly.
adaptive-core.invariants: PAR5 is physical $34; histories contain at most eight complete eighteen-byte records each; pending publication and transient barriers forbid catch-up.

adaptive-active.inputs: Foreground phase/input/intent state, callback class or audio action in A, scheduler aliases and selected BACK owner.
adaptive-active.outputs: Real simulation, keyed/global composition and audio servicing; successful render prepares one complete BACK publication.
adaptive-active.clobbers: A, B, D, X, Y, U and condition codes except source-preserved values; stack returns balanced.
adaptive-active.reads: Presentation/game/enemy/input state, both damage journals, installed callbacks and audio imports.
adaptive-active.writes: Game and enemy simulation state, BACK pixels/metadata, current intents and declared scheduler aliases.
adaptive-active.side_effects: Scans input, maps audio page $3D through its installed API and returns PAR5 to $34; calls existing framebuffer completion.
adaptive-active.invariants: Code is installed only for active gameplay/demo; demo input is excluded; every actor is restored and redrawn; static handoffs do not accrue simulation debt.

routines.name: adaptive_clock
routines.purpose: Atomically snapshot the IRQ clock while preserving caller IRQ state.

routines.name: adaptive_reset
routines.purpose: Clear both damage histories and scheduler state, then initialize clock and cadence.

routines.name: adaptive_append
routines.purpose: Append a complete intent record to both histories after checking both capacities.

routines.name: aa_record
routines.purpose: Copy and filter one eighteen-byte intent record into the selected history.

routines.name: adaptive_complete
routines.purpose: Consume only the composed owner and update publication cadence and barrier identity.

routines.name: adaptive_batch
routines.purpose: Advance at most four due logical steps while honoring histories, publication and transient barriers.

routines.name: adaptive_reduce
routines.purpose: Reduce the selected owner history and replay final global and keyed damage before actor drawing.

routines.name: adr_present
routines.purpose: Test whether the current record contains the selected keyed damage class.

routines.name: adr_newer
routines.purpose: Find a newer matching keyed damage record in the selected owner history.

routines.name: adr_load
routines.purpose: Restore the selected record intent fields for its drawing callback.

routines.name: adaptive_work
routines.purpose: Run elapsed audio/input, reserve journal capacity, batch simulation and publish complete composed work.

routines.name: adaptive_credit_history
routines.purpose: Merge credit HUD damage into both retained histories without exceeding eight records.

routines.name: adaptive_render
routines.purpose: Restore actors, reduce the selected damage history and redraw every actor into BACK.

routines.name: adaptive_audio_binding
routines.purpose: Call the banked adaptive audio API and restore physical page $34.

routines.name: adaptive_tick_binding
routines.purpose: Run one real gameplay or demo logical step and report mandatory transient barriers.

routines.name: adaptive_global_binding
routines.purpose: Draw one selected global damage class while preserving caller intents.

routines.name: adaptive_key_binding
routines.purpose: Draw one selected keyed damage class using the existing background compositor.

routines.name: pickup_key_prepare
routines.purpose: Repair removed keyed entity footprint, intersecting settled gate unions and structural nest intent.
